name: Contacts
description: The person's address book: the system's contact picker (no permission), reading the contacts behind the contacts permission, adding and editing through the system's own editor (Contacts / ContactsUI, ContactsContract). No write permission. On the web: the browser's Contact Picker. The app's side is Contacts.

infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: The app reads your contacts to show them in the app.
